title: Diagnostic estimate of tagged-PDF compilation cost
interpretation: This single sequential pair suggests that PDF tagging and structure finalization account for a substantial share of one-pass work in this fixture. The result only motivates further profiling of tagpdf while preserving structure; it does not justify disabling tagging.
limitations: One run per variant, always tagging-on first; cache and order effects are uncontrolled.
One direct pass only. Both outputs contain unresolved page references and are diagnostic files, not final previews.
The untagged variant has no accessibility structure and is not a production candidate.
Synthetic branching fixture with no media on one macOS and TeX Live environment; no inference to all books or systems.
No PDF accessibility checker or screen-reader assessment was performed.
